verdict.rationale: Runpod's own docs describe an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to network volumes without launching a Pod. Its open-source runpodctl CLI documents transferring files between your system and Runpod. Data ingress and egress are free, which supports efficient movement in and out. missing for 10: no documented cloud-storage sync (e.g., syncing to and from external S3/GCS buckets), no independent or hands-on corroboration of S3 API or transfer performance, and thin detail on S3 API coverage.
